profile.headline: Software Engineer | Target
profile.summary:
Ever since I was little, I've been intrigued by computers and the various activities that I could engage with on them. Using the monstrous monitor and desktop computer we had at home, I'd fiddle around with HTML and CSS to customize my Neopets pets' pages or build an entire world on VMK, the hot mid-2000s massively multiplayer online game.

I went on to teach low-income adults digital literacy skills at a non-profit's career center for two years through AmeriCorps. Little did I know that the privilege I had growing up around a computer–even a clunky one–gave me a leg up in our digitally-expanding world. Through this experience, I got to see myself as a child through these adults in utter shock and amazement about all the incredible things that can be accomplished online. Using maps to navigate around the new city I relocated to for my AmeriCorps position was second nature for me, especially as someone who gets perpetually lost. However, for these adults, it became a new tool in their toolkits.

This experience made it clear that the technology space is where I belonged. Through my enrollment in Hackbright Academy, becoming a software engineer was no longer just a possibility, but what I dreamed of doing. Now, I get to have fun solving problems and writing code that I know will have an impact among my community.

positions.title: Software Engineering Fellow
positions.description: Created an interactive web application that allows the user to search for cafes in their area. It utilizes the Yelp API, Google Places API, and Cloudinary API. Built with Flask, Python, Jinja, SQL, SQLAlchemy, JQuery, HTML, and CSS.
